name: ISAIAH
canonical: Isaiah the prophet, son of Amoz, an aged Hebrew seer of Judah of about sixty, weathered olive skin, a grave lean lined face, long iron-grey hair and a full grey beard, intent reverent eyes and ink-stained fingers, robed in a coarse undyed sackcloth-brown prophet's mantle and head-cloth, bent over an unrolled scroll writing the vision by hand with a reed pen
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
